subject.title: improve(qa): align Telegram coverage with startup behavior

question: After https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/114055 is accepted or replaced, should this Telegram-only follow-up be rebased onto that final selection contract and merged as the evidence/coverage companion change?
rationale: The remaining question is stack sequencing and acceptance of the parent QA architecture, not a mechanical defect in this branch; the author is also a repository member and the PR carries the protected maintainer label.

options.title: Land parent, then rebase this follow-up
options.body: Merge or otherwise settle the taxonomy-selection refactor, rebase this branch onto the resulting main, and require exact-head QA smoke evidence before merging this focused change.

options.title: Fold the follow-up into the parent
options.body: If maintainers prefer one atomic QA selection change, incorporate these Telegram evidence updates into the parent PR and close this stacked branch after preserving its useful commits.

recommendation.title: Land parent, then rebase this follow-up
recommendation.body: Merge or otherwise settle the taxonomy-selection refactor, rebase this branch onto the resulting main, and require exact-head QA smoke evidence before merging this focused change.
